content:
maria: Heads-up — Acct acct_4A9 (AcmePay) opened a ticket: promo code applied earlier, then a refund/chargeback hit their card and now trial/promo credits were clawed back leaving them at -$120. Customer is threatening to escalate. Can billing triage?

sanjay: tagging @maya and @ron. any quick visibility on clawback rules?

maya: we have a clawback policy: when provider issues a refund/chargeback we reverse promo credits tied to that charge. That can create negative balances if refunds > stored credits.

jen: customer says they never requested refund, they only disputed a single invoice. They pasted the Stripe dispute id in the ticket.

kevin: quick repro steps i ran: `redwood-cli accounts balance --id acct_4A9` -> shows `balance_cents: -12000`, `promo_credits_remaining_cents: 0`.

billing-bot: Payment event processed: chargeback.created id=chb_01F23 at 2026-03-12T18:04:22Z amount_cents=20000 currency=usd

maya: ledger extract for acct_4A9:
```
2026-03-05 promo_grant promo_2026SPRING +10000
2026-03-09 usage charge -3000
2026-03-12 payment_refund/chargeback -20000
-- balance -12000
```

ron: looks like refund > credits which caused negative balance. For chargebacks the gateway typically reduces our merchant balance; we claw credits to reflect that.

maria: customer insists we should not remove their trial credits because they say dispute was a mistake. How do we safely resolve without exposing us to chargeback risk?

maya: options:
- wait for dispute resolution (could take 7–90 days) and keep them in negative (not great customer experience)
- issue a temporary goodwill credit to bring them to 0 while dispute is ongoing (we expose risk if dispute loses)
- work with payments team to challenge dispute if we have proof of service

jen: customer is small but urgent. They want immediate access. Suggest temp credit + add note to prevent another promo grant.

kevin: operationally we can create a one-off ledger entry: `promo_temporary_reversal_hold +12000` with metadata dispute_id. We should mark it reversible. I'll raise a BILL ticket and a hold flag on account to auto-reconcile.

maya: agree. I'll create BILL-4578 (P1) and set a sunset date 30 days. We'll tag accounting to monitor dispute outcome. If dispute is lost, we'll claw back the temp credit and reapply negative balance.

ron: pls include payload for accounting: customer id, original promo id, chargeback id, timestamps, and our temporary credit txn id. I need that to record contingent liabilities.

maria: copied. jen — can you communicate to the customer: we can temporarily restore access while we investigate, explain it may change depending on dispute outcome? Keep it non-technical.

jen: message drafted to customer:
"Hi — we restored access while we investigate a billing dispute. If the dispute is resolved in your favor, nothing else is needed. If the payment provider finalizes a chargeback, we may need to reverse the temporary credit and bill any outstanding balance. We're monitoring and will update you within 7 business days. — Jen, Redwood Support"

maria: perfect. maya — please confirm when temp credit applied and add accounting tag.

maya: applied `promo_temp_hold_txn_9f3b` +12000 cents at 2026-03-13T09:12:00Z, note=manent:dispute:chb_01F23, expires=2026-04-12. Tagging @ron.

billing-bot: Ledger update recorded tx=promo_temp_hold_txn_9f3b status=pending_reversible

ron: got it, recorded contingent credit, assigned to accounting queue ACG-82.

kevin: created BILL-4578, assigned to maya, priority P1.

maria: OK closing loop here. Action items: maya create BILL ticket + temp credit (done), ron account for contingent liability, jen notify customer (done), kevin add hold and reconcile. We'll wait for dispute outcome and follow up.

jen: customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick help." :thumbsup:

maria: will update thread when dispute resolves. If anyone sees similar patterns, please escalate to billing immediately.

maya: follow-up: dispute was marked won (customer) on 2026-03-18; we reversed the temp credit and restored the original promo credit on 2026-03-19, final balance  -3000 -> after restoration balance 7000 cents available promo. Closing BILL-4578.

maria: resolved. closing thread.
